name: Witten (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Witten (a red heraldic beast on white above a plain white base).
history: Municipal flag of Witten; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Witten arms — red heraldic beast on white
